column1: # Iliad - Part 2 — naskah 03 (M24003): Chiloveig menyusul jejak The Elmo, bertemu Graurizard
# yang terikat, lalu debat dengan Ateraxis soal Nirvana dan cita-cita Caldwell.
# Tetap Inggris: Chiloveig, Ateraxis, Graurizard, Jojo, Nirvana, Boojum, Relic,
# Caldwell Scarlett, Teacher Scarlett, URNC, Lviv, ELID, Doll, Commander, The Elmo,
# Valkyrie, Mother, Doctor, Goddess, Paradeus.
(Two hours ago.)
column2: (Dua jam sebelumnya.)

column1: ("Rustle—")
column2: ("Srek—")

column1: (Chiloveig walks forward alone, following the tracks left by The Elmo.)
column2: (Chiloveig melangkah maju sendirian, mengikuti jejak yang ditinggalkan The Elmo.)

column1: (Barefoot, she leaves a trail of deep and shallow footprints in the sand.)
column2: (Bertelanjang kaki, dia meninggalkan deretan tapak yang dalam dan tipis di atas pasir.)

column1: Honestly...
column2: Sejujurnya...

column1: I wanted to take a private jet over there too.
column2: Aku juga mau naik jet pribadi ke sana.

column1: Even though the wind is a bit strong, and we'd often encounter turbulent air currents...
column2: Meski anginnya agak kencang, dan sering kena arus udara yang bergejolak...

column1: But at least it's much faster than walking.
column2: Tapi setidaknya jauh lebih cepat dari jalan kaki.

column1: Sigh, that young lady is really stingy—
column2: Haah, nona itu benar-benar pelit—

column1: There were clearly still empty seats up there!
column2: Di atas jelas masih ada kursi kosong!

column1: (Chiloveig complained all the way like this.)
column2: (Chiloveig mengeluh seperti itu sepanjang jalan.)

column1: (Although she didn't have a travel companion by her side, even talking to herself made the atmosphere exceptionally noisy.)
column2: (Meski tidak ada teman perjalanan di sisinya, berbicara sendiri saja sudah membuat suasananya luar biasa berisik.)

column1: Huh? What's that...
column2: Hm? Apa itu...

column1: (Chiloveig narrowed her eyes, trying to focus her gaze on a massive unidentified object in the distance.)
column2: (Chiloveig menyipitkan mata, berusaha memusatkan pandangan pada benda raksasa tak dikenal di kejauhan.)

column1: (Immediately after, she realized it was actually struggling and roaring.)
column2: (Sesaat kemudian, dia menyadari benda itu ternyata sedang meronta dan meraung.)

column1: (—It was actually that 'private jet'.)
column2: (—Ternyata itu 'jet pribadi' yang dimaksud.)

column1: Oh my, how surprising.
column2: Aduh, mengejutkan sekali.

column1: I thought you guys had already...
column2: Kupikir kalian sudah...

column1: Roar—!
column2: Grrroaar—!

column1: Eek—don't be mean to me!
column2: Iiih—jangan galak padaku!

column1: (Chiloveig is startled by the giant dragon's roar and jumps back a large step.)
column2: (Chiloveig terkejut oleh raungan naga raksasa itu dan melompat mundur satu langkah lebar.)

column1: (Only after discovering that Graurizard was firmly pinned to the ground by steel cables did she tiptoe closer to it again.)
column2: (Baru setelah tahu Graurizard terpasak kuat ke tanah oleh kabel baja, dia berjingkat mendekat lagi.)

column1: Hup~
column2: Hop~

column1: Little cutie, who tied you up like this?
column2: Manis, siapa yang mengikatmu seperti ini?

column1: Ah, needless to say, I can guess—
column2: Ah, tidak perlu dijawab, aku bisa menebak—

column1: It's that Knight Highness and his princesses, right?
column2: Itu Sang Knight beserta putri-putrinya, kan?

column1: Oh my, looking like this now, it's really suitable for conducting research~
column2: Aduh, dalam keadaan seperti ini, kau benar-benar cocok untuk diteliti~

column1: Hehe, I've never studied a Boojum in this form before~
column2: Hehe, aku belum pernah meneliti Boojum dalam bentuk seperti ini~

column1: There will definitely be new discoveries, right?
column2: Pasti akan ada temuan baru, kan?

column1: (Chiloveig extended a finger and tremblingly poked the dragon's scales.)
column2: (Chiloveig mengulurkan satu jari dan menyentuh sisik naga itu dengan gemetar.)

column1: Ah~ So this is what it feels like~
column2: Ah~ Jadi begini rasanya~

column1: Truly wonderful~
column2: Benar-benar luar biasa~

column1: Hiss—!
column2: Hsss—!

column1: Whoa—so fierce!
column2: Wah—galak sekali!

column1: (Chiloveig instantly retreated over ten meters.)
column2: (Chiloveig seketika mundur lebih dari sepuluh meter.)

column1: But... where did your driver go?
column2: Tapi... ke mana pengemudimu pergi?

column1: Did they go track Sir Knight?
column2: Apa dia pergi melacak Tuan Knight?

column1: No, no, without a sacrifice—meaning you—even with the treasures in the Knight's castle, she wouldn't be able to open the door of truth.
column2: Tidak, tidak, tanpa tumbal—maksudku kau—meski dia punya harta di kastel Knight itu, dia tidak akan bisa membuka pintu kebenaran.

column1: Too bad that even if you get there, it's not certain whether you can enter the door~
column2: Sayangnya meski sampai di sana, belum tentu kau bisa masuk pintunya~

column1: Jojo is not a sacrifice; she is my sister.
column2: Jojo bukan tumbal; dia saudaraku.

column1: (Chiloveig's shoulders suddenly flinched, making her already not-so-tall figure appear even more petite.)
column2: (Bahu Chiloveig tiba-tiba tersentak, membuat tubuhnya yang sudah tidak tinggi tampak makin kerdil.)

column1: Cough, gulp... Ah, oh my, it's little Ateraxis.
column2: Uhuk, glek... Ah, aduh, ternyata Ateraxis Kecil.

column1: (She slowly turned around, trying her best not to meet Ateraxis's cold eyes.)
column2: (Dia berbalik perlahan, berusaha sekuat tenaga tidak bertemu mata dingin Ateraxis.)

column1: (The girl walked up to Chiloveig, reached out, and pinched her chin.)
column2: (Gadis itu melangkah ke arah Chiloveig, mengulurkan tangan, dan mencengkeram dagunya.)

column1: Guh—it hurts—
column2: Ugh—sakit—

column1: You're hiding something from me.
column2: Kau menyembunyikan sesuatu dariku.

column1: H-how could I...
column2: M-mana mungkin aku...

column1: I-I-I... I just wanted to say...
column2: A-a-aku... aku cuma mau bilang...

column1: What is it?
column2: Apa itu?

column1: Um, it's actually nothing much, just that, even if you reach Nirvana, 'she' still has the right to decide whether to let someone in.
column2: Emm, sebenarnya bukan hal besar, cuma, meski kau sampai di Nirvana, 'dia' tetap punya hak menentukan siapa yang boleh masuk.

column1: So, last time, although you entered Nirvana, you were rejected.
column2: Jadi, waktu itu, meski kau masuk ke Nirvana, kau ditolak.

column1: It's not like you said, that you got the knowledge you wanted inside, right?
column2: Bukan seperti yang kau bilang, bahwa kau mendapat pengetahuan yang kau inginkan di dalam, kan?

column1: W-well, even if that's the case—after all, I'm a genius, so being envied by a goddess makes sense!
column2: Y-yah, kalaupun begitu—lagi pula aku ini genius, jadi wajar kalau dicemburui seorang dewi!

column1: Little Ateraxis, you're so cute, you'll definitely be invited!
column2: Ateraxis Kecil, kau manis sekali, kau pasti diundang!

column1: The 'Goddess' in Nirvana has the ability to decide who can enter.
column2: 'Goddess' di Nirvana punya kemampuan menentukan siapa yang boleh masuk.

column1: But she didn't stop you from opening the door, which shows that her ability to intervene in this world is very limited.
column2: Tapi dia tidak menghentikanmu membuka pintunya, yang menunjukkan kemampuannya ikut campur di dunia ini sangat terbatas.

column1: After all, it's another world, even the laws are completely different from reality! Cough cough cough—it hurts so much, little Ateraxis, alright... put me down quickly.
column2: Lagi pula itu dunia lain, bahkan hukumnya sepenuhnya berbeda dari kenyataan! Uhuk uhuk uhuk—sakit sekali, Ateraxis Kecil, sudah... cepat turunkan aku.

column1: Mother also said that Nirvana might refuse my entry, and said that if that happens, I should just honestly back out and not force anything.
column2: Mother juga bilang Nirvana mungkin menolakku masuk, dan bilang kalau itu terjadi aku harus jujur mundur dan tidak memaksakan apa pun.

column1: Teacher Scarlett is always like this! She clearly did a lot of work, but doesn't mind failing. All that fuss for nothing, that's what I hate about her—
column2: Teacher Scarlett selalu begitu! Dia jelas mengerjakan banyak hal, tapi tidak masalah kalau gagal. Ribut sebesar itu untuk hasil nol, itu yang kubenci darinya—

column1: Don't you dare underestimate Mother.
column2: Jangan berani-berani meremehkan Mother.

column1: Cough cough—!? I just disagree, that's all!
column2: Uhuk uhuk—!? Aku cuma tidak setuju, itu saja!

column1: Mother said that success only needs to happen once. No matter how many times you fail, you are just piling up the stepping stones leading to it.
column2: Mother bilang keberhasilan hanya perlu terjadi sekali. Sebanyak apa pun kau gagal, kau cuma menumpuk pijakan yang menuju ke sana.

column1: Even successfully entering Nirvana is just completing one step, not the end point. If I am rejected, she will just try other methods to create a child more suitable than me.
column2: Bahkan berhasil masuk Nirvana hanya menuntaskan satu langkah, bukan titik akhir. Kalau aku ditolak, dia akan mencoba cara lain untuk menciptakan anak yang lebih cocok dariku.

column1: But I will let Mother know that I will absolutely not be rejected. Not even the 'Goddess' can shut me out.
column2: Tapi aku akan membuat Mother tahu bahwa aku sama sekali tidak akan ditolak. 'Goddess' pun tidak bisa menutup pintu untukku.

column1: Right, right, that's what I think too—
column2: Benar, benar, aku juga berpikir begitu—

column1: If it's little Ateraxis, even if she gets the door slammed in her face, she can definitely break it down!
column2: Kalau Ateraxis Kecil, meski pintunya dibanting di depan hidungnya, dia pasti bisa mendobraknya!

column1: (Chiloveig felt the strength in Ateraxis's hand slightly relaxing.)
column2: (Chiloveig merasakan cengkeraman tangan Ateraxis sedikit melonggar.)

column1: T-That's right, little Ateraxis... I'm on your side.
column2: B-benar, Ateraxis Kecil... aku di pihakmu.

column1: After all, if I hadn't opened the door in Lviv that day, you wouldn't have been born smoothly—so don't you think I could also be considered your mother? Y-You have to be gentle with me~
column2: Lagi pula kalau hari itu aku tidak membuka pintu di Lviv, kau tidak akan lahir dengan lancar—jadi bukankah aku juga bisa dihitung sebagai ibumu? K-kau harus lembut padaku~

column1: J-just kidding—that was definitely a joke!
column2: C-cuma bercanda—itu jelas cuma gurauan!

column1: I'm only providing you with shelter because your knowledge is useful to me.
column2: Aku memberimu tempat berlindung hanya karena pengetahuanmu berguna bagiku.

column1: But concealed and tampered knowledge is a toxin. If I find out the information you give is false—
column2: Tapi pengetahuan yang disembunyikan dan diutak-atik adalah racun. Kalau kutahu informasi yang kau beri itu palsu—

column1: (Ateraxis suddenly tightened her grip, almost crushing her jaw.)
column2: (Ateraxis tiba-tiba mengencangkan cengkeramannya, hampir menghancurkan rahang Chiloveig.)

column1: I'll send you back to the 'Doctor'.
column2: Akan kukembalikan kau ke 'Doctor'.

column1: ...Don't!
column2: ...Jangan!

column1: (Chiloveig squeezed out a word through her teeth with all her might.)
column2: (Chiloveig memaksa keluar satu kata dari sela giginya dengan sekuat tenaga.)

column1: (Immediately after, Ateraxis finally let go of her hand.)
column2: (Sesaat kemudian, Ateraxis akhirnya melepaskan tangannya.)

column1: Pant... pant...
column2: Hah... hah...

column1: H-how could I lie to you~
column2: M-mana mungkin aku membohongimu~

column1: Things aren't like they used to be. I value my life very much... Haha...
column2: Keadaan tidak seperti dulu lagi. Aku sangat menghargai nyawaku... Haha...

column1: So, are we going to chase after them now?
column2: Jadi, kita akan mengejar mereka sekarang?

column1: The Commander just proved that even facing me, they will firmly resist to the very end.
column2: Commander baru saja membuktikan bahwa meski menghadapiku, mereka akan melawan dengan keras sampai akhir.

column1: (Ateraxis waved her hand, and a fleeting long blade flashed, easily slicing through the towing cables on Graurizard.)
column2: (Ateraxis melambaikan tangan, dan sebuah bilah panjang berkelebat sekejap, dengan mudah mengiris kabel penambat di tubuh Graurizard.)

column1: (The dragon slowly turned around, resting its head in Ateraxis's arms, accepting the girl's comfort.)
column2: (Naga itu berbalik perlahan, menyandarkan kepalanya di pelukan Ateraxis, menerima usapan gadis itu.)

column1: (Ateraxis, showing a loving expression, seemed to radiate a beauty that could serve as a totem of human faith, even in Chiloveig's eyes.)
column2: (Ateraxis, dengan ekspresi penuh kasih, seolah memancarkan keindahan yang bisa jadi totem keimanan manusia, bahkan di mata Chiloveig.)

column1: (An unconcealable resentment and jealousy flowed from the depths of her eyes. Ateraxis might have noticed, but she didn't care.)
column2: (Kebencian dan kecemburuan yang tak bisa disembunyikan mengalir dari dasar matanya. Ateraxis mungkin menyadarinya, tapi dia tidak peduli.)

column1: It's fine, this place is already very close to the "Valkyrie's" hunting ground.
column2: Tidak masalah, tempat ini sudah sangat dekat dengan wilayah buruan "Valkyrie".

column1: With the coordinates I sent over, you'll definitely catch them~
column2: Dengan koordinat yang kukirim, kau pasti menangkap mereka~

column1: ...Is that so.
column2: ...Begitu ya.

column1: I hope she doesn't break those crucial things, otherwise, I might get angry.
column2: Kuharap dia tidak merusak benda-benda krusial itu, kalau tidak, aku bisa marah.

column1: I say, little Ateraxis.
column2: Begini ya, Ateraxis Kecil.

column1: Excuse me?
column2: Apa?

column1: Even though you didn't answer before, I've already proven my worth, haven't I?
column2: Meski tadi kau tidak menjawab, aku sudah membuktikan nilaiku, kan?

column1: So, could you answer me just a little?
column2: Jadi, bisakah kau menjawabku sedikit saja?

column1: Acting on your own even if it means defying your favorite "Mom", what do you plan to do if you meet that "Goddess"?
column2: Bergerak sendiri sampai berani membangkang "Mom" favoritmu, apa yang akan kau lakukan kalau bertemu "Goddess" itu?

column1: I just want to ask some questions.
column2: Aku hanya ingin menanyakan beberapa hal.

column1: Hee~ Who isn't? Don't make your big sis Chi laugh.
column2: Hii~ Siapa yang tidak? Jangan membuat Big Sis Chi ini tertawa.

column1: As Mother's disciple, do you know her wish?
column2: Sebagai murid Mother, kau tahu apa keinginannya?

column1: Ehehehe, to be honest, I'm not very interested in idealism. I always feel it's full of hypocrisy and childishness... Ah, but, but, I do really like Teacher Scarlett's theory about the 'new civilization'!
column2: Ehehehe, sejujurnya aku tidak begitu tertarik pada idealisme. Aku selalu merasa itu penuh kepura-puraan dan sifat kekanakan... Ah, tapi, tapi, aku memang sangat suka teori Teacher Scarlett soal 'peradaban baru'!

column1: (Chiloveig hugged her thin shoulders under her sleeves, revealing a somewhat nostalgic smile.)
column2: (Chiloveig memeluk bahunya yang tipis di balik lengan bajunya, menampakkan senyum yang agak nostalgia.)

column1: ('Using Relic technology as the starting point of a new civilization rather than the end point of the old civilization. To this end, it is necessary to subvert all existing human systems and forms, and even humanity itself must change.')
column2: ('Menjadikan teknologi Relic sebagai titik awal peradaban baru, bukan titik akhir peradaban lama. Untuk itu, seluruh sistem dan bentuk manusia yang ada sekarang harus dijungkirkan, dan manusia itu sendiri pun harus berubah.')

column1: (It is said that before colluding with Paradeus, Caldwell Scarlett was once imprisoned in her hometown for a speech. Although she herself didn't care much about it, it gives a glimpse of her unorthodoxy.)
column2: (Dikatakan bahwa sebelum bersekongkol dengan Paradeus, Caldwell Scarlett pernah dipenjara di kampungnya karena sebuah pidato. Meski dia sendiri tidak begitu memedulikannya, itu memberi gambaran betapa dia tidak mengikuti pakem.)

column1: (Not long ago, she gave a new speech at a science summit. Although the content was much more restrained, it still encountered a lot of criticism. If it weren't for the strong protection of the URNC higher-ups, she might have been expelled from the list of researchers.)
column2: (Belum lama ini dia menyampaikan pidato baru di sebuah KTT sains. Meski isinya jauh lebih tertahan, dia tetap menerima banyak kecaman. Kalau bukan karena perlindungan kuat kalangan atas URNC, dia mungkin sudah dicoret dari daftar peneliti.)

column1: The foundation of this new civilization will be rooted in Nirvana. Mother believes that every individual in it should receive the grace of Nirvana, and contribute all their knowledge and power for the prosperity of the civilization.
column2: Fondasi peradaban baru itu akan berakar di Nirvana. Mother percaya setiap individu di dalamnya harus menerima berkah Nirvana, dan menyumbangkan seluruh pengetahuan serta kekuatannya demi kemakmuran peradaban itu.

column1: That 'Goddess' did say something like 'knowledge is a curse'. It seems Teacher's curse is also very deep~!
column2: 'Goddess' itu memang pernah bilang 'pengetahuan adalah kutukan'. Sepertinya kutukan Teacher juga sangat dalam~!

column1: However, assuming everyone is cursed, then no one is cursed. But when that time comes, how can we guarantee that everyone is willing?
column2: Namun kalau semua orang terkutuk, berarti tidak ada yang terkutuk. Tapi kalau sudah begitu, bagaimana kita menjamin semua orang bersedia?

column1: Having one competitor is enough.
column2: Cukup ada satu pesaing.

column1: Mother believes that competition is not just a life-and-death struggle, but the driving force for progress and unity.
column2: Mother percaya persaingan bukan hanya pergulatan hidup-mati, tapi tenaga pendorong kemajuan dan persatuan.

column1: This can happen between two races, between two civilizations, or even between humans and Dolls, humans and ELIDs, or humans and another newly encountered race.
column2: Itu bisa terjadi antara dua ras, antara dua peradaban, atau bahkan antara manusia dan Doll, manusia dan ELID, atau manusia dan ras lain yang baru dijumpai.

column1: The key is to be able to form an equal competition with each other, rather than one side crushing the other.
column2: Kuncinya adalah bisa membentuk persaingan yang setara, bukan satu pihak menghancurkan yang lain.

column1: Since struggle is the instinct of life, let the struggle itself have meaning.
column2: Karena pergulatan adalah insting kehidupan, biarkan pergulatan itu sendiri punya makna.

column1: ...Then, who does the teacher want to compete with whom? Although everyone evaluates her as cynical, she doesn't really have any anti-social tendencies. Let's assume human contestants can qualify, then humanity's opponent is...
column2: ...Lalu, teacher ingin siapa bersaing dengan siapa? Meski semua orang menilainya sinis, dia sebenarnya tidak punya kecenderungan antisosial. Anggap saja peserta dari pihak manusia lolos, maka lawan manusia adalah...

column1: It's me.
column2: Aku.

column1: Mother said I am her most perfect creation, meeting her standards in every aspect.
column2: Mother bilang aku ciptaan tersempurnanya, memenuhi standarnya di semua aspek.

column1: Therefore, I am very suited to be the enemy of humanity, leading another civilization to form the competitive relationship Mother expects.
column2: Karena itu aku sangat cocok jadi musuh manusia, memimpin satu peradaban lain untuk membentuk hubungan persaingan yang diharapkan Mother.

column1: ...As crazy as that person, as expected. Compared to them, aren't I, Chiloveig, a good kid?
column2: ...Segila orang itu, sudah kuduga. Dibanding kalian, bukankah aku, Chiloveig, ini anak baik?

column1: But, little Ateraxis, you said you defied the teacher, which means you have other plans?
column2: Tapi, Ateraxis Kecil, kau bilang kau membangkangi teacher, berarti kau punya rencana lain?

column1: (Ateraxis paid no mind to Chiloveig's question.)
column2: (Ateraxis tidak memedulikan pertanyaan Chiloveig.)

column1: (She gazed into the distance—where a light was gradually gathering.)
column2: (Dia menatap ke kejauhan—tempat sebuah cahaya perlahan berkumpul.)

column1: (That was a spear of destruction cast by human technology, aimed at someone who could be called a 'hero' of this era, capable of piercing the heavens.)
column2: (Itu adalah tombak kehancuran hasil tempaan teknologi manusia, mampu menembus langit, yang diarahkan kepada seseorang yang bisa disebut 'pahlawan' era ini.)
